notes.title: Clicker Warriors Monthly Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. It has been 1 month since we released Clicker Warriors. We've worked hard to resolve any issues with the help of feedbacks from our community. We will continue to improve Clicker Warriors and looking forward to hear your thoughts about the latest state of the game.

[b]Here is what we have added, improved and fixed so far;[/b]

[b]New features[/b]
[list]
[*] New guest system added. Players who don't want to create accounts, can now play as guests and activate their account whenever they like.
[*] Talent system completely reworked. All talent multipliers and costs has been adjusted.
[*] New auto loot system added. No more loot popups.
[*] Attribute system added.
[*] New base stat system added. All warriors can be upgraded individually.
[*] New tutorial system added. Old tutorial was not informative and had too many issues. We completely reworked tutorials.
[*] Added new companion which applies click damage to the enemy.
[*] Offline progression system added. Warriors will progress levels and loot items while offline.
[*] Players can save the progress manually.
[/list]
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] General balance of Clicker Warriors has been improved and changed.
[*] Revival effectiveness increased.
[*] All unbalanced item stats has been adjusted.
[*] Gear effectiveness increased.
[*] Anti-Cheat system has been improved.
[*] Cheater detection system improved.
[*] Boss gives extra loot.
[*] All skill cool downs are reduced greatly.
[*] Energy consumption reduced for more click damages.
[*] Adjusted all daily rewards which will reward much more.
[*] Talents can be upgraded quickly by holding down the button.
[*] All warrior active and passive skills has been adjusted.
[*] Boost buff duration increased greatly.
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Lots of server and login issues has been fixed.
[*] Mobile (Ad issues has been fixed).
[*] Graphical glitches and missing components has been fixed.
[*] Animation issues has been fixed.
[*] Fixed daily rewards.
[*] Password recovery issues fixed.
[*] Button ray cast issues fixed.
[*] All achievement related issues fixed.
[*] Major exploits like gold bug, level bug and much more has been fixed.
[*] IAP fixed for iOS.
[*] Talent related issues fixed.
[/list]
[b]Backend[/b]
[list]
[*] Lots of server stabilization improvements has been made.
[*] Network communication improvements.
[*] Safer network communication between server and client.
[/list]

There are much more fixes and improvements. We wanted to share only the most important ones.

Also we are looking forward to hear your honest review about Clicker Warriors. We are trying hard to create a successful game and your feedback is very important. If you have any negative thoughts about Clicker Warriors feel free to share with us. We will definitely hear you and fix any kind of issues as soon as possible.

notes.title: Clicker Warriors 2.1.20 - 2.1.28 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Added new auto loot system. Auto loot works only if there is empty slot in inventory. If inventory is full, the system starts to stack items.
    [*] Added auto loot button which is located inside the inventory. By using this button auto loot can be enabled or disabled.
    [*] Added button to save the current progress of the game.
    [*] Offline gain system changed. Now you can progress and loot items while offline.
    [*] Talents can be upgraded quickly by holding down the increase level button.
[/list]

[h1]Balancing[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Reduced the speed of Assassin by 50%.
    [*] Balancing scaled down.
[/list]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Level change buttons are now disabled while charge skill is active.
    [*] Upgrade scrolls can be added to craft slots again.
    [*] Send items to craft slots button only sends craft items first. Upgrade scrolls will be sent if there aren't any craft items left.
    [*] Tutorials will be enabled sequential slower.
    [*] Locking progress will be unlocked upon revival.
    [*] Boost bonus duration is now greatly increased.
    [*] Boost duration is now displayed.
    [*] Raycast area on buttons are now larger. It's now easier to click or tap on menu buttons.
    [*] Talent window scale rate changed.
    [*] Items inside crafting slots are now saved to the database.
    [*] Safer transaction system implemented.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Items stat issues fixed.
    [*] IAP on iOS is now working.
    [*] Character selection screen text issues fixed.
    [*] Multiplier hitbox issues solved.
    [*] Fixed some talent issues but caused another not game breaking issue.
    [*] Fixed some assertions related script not found because of the localization changes.
    [*] Ground minions height fixes.
    [*] Fixed effect locator issues.
    [*] Fixed background asset issues.
    [*] Talent exception fixed.
    [*] Notification circles fixed.
    [*] Revive bug fixed which caused character selection screen not appear.
    [*] Fixed character screen header text issues.
    [*] Ad request window sorting group fix.
[/list]

[h1]Backend[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Server stabilization improvements.
    [*] Network communication improvements.
    [*] Server port fixes.
    [*] Safer network communication between server and client.
    [*]Addressed the ServerNotResponding error.
[/list]

notes.title: Clicker Warriors – Second Beta Release Date!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, finally we are very excited to announce our second beta date. We are planning to release the second beta on [b]08 August 2019[/b].

We made some big progress on Clicker Warriors. We have changed the item system completely and now the system will able us to create new item sets very easily. Also this system compares item stats and let us know if there is an unbalanced stat or feature.

We are now using an advanced server management system to monitor all accounts and detect any issues and possible cheats.

We added new coin and item effects. The visual feedback of how much we loot or gather is improved.

We improved our UI system according to feedbacks from you.

Overall performance of the game is much better now. We aim to give the best Clicker Warriors experience to all of our player base.
